cards.card_text: Then God hands Noah the building plans: gopher wood, rooms, pitch inside and out, a roof, a door in the side, three decks, and 300 cubits long.
cards.verse_text: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out.
cards.snippet: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside…
